briefs.speaker: Dr. Amish Adolgez
briefs.speaker_context: Infectious disease expert and senior scholar at Johns Hopkins University Center for Health Security
briefs.current_title: 约翰霍普金斯专家：麻疹病例创30年新高，疫苗率下降是主因

subtitles.zh: CDC周五发布令人担忧的数据，今年美国麻疹病例已达2318例。
subtitles.en: In less cheerful news and alarming statistics from the CDC on Friday, the number of measles cases this year in the United States hit 2,318.

subtitles.zh: 超过去年全年总数，创下1991年以来最高纪录。
subtitles.en: That's higher than all of last year and is now the most infection since 1991.

subtitles.zh: 麻疹问题很简单：疫苗接种率降至群体免疫阈值以下。
subtitles.en: With measles, it's really a no-brainer. We got there because vaccination rates fell below the herd immunity threshold.

subtitles.zh: 麻疹是人类面临的最具传染性的疾病，需要高水平人群免疫，且在全球多地传播。
subtitles.en: And we're talking about what is the most contagious infectious disease that we humans face, one that requires a high level of immunity in the population, and one in which it's circulating in many parts of the world.

subtitles.zh: 我们一旦降低防护，麻疹就卷土重来——它从未消失。
subtitles.en: So all it took was for us to lower our armor, to lower our force field, and then measles came back. It never went away.

subtitles.zh: 解决方案同样简单：让未接种者接种疫苗，问题就会消失。
subtitles.en: And the solution is equally simple. It's just to get more vaccine into the arms of people who are unvaccinated and then this problem will disappear.

briefs.speaker: Dr. Amish Adolgez
briefs.speaker_context: Infectious disease expert and senior scholar at Johns Hopkins University Center for Health Security
briefs.current_title: 专家解答：成年人是否需要麻疹疫苗加强针？
current_title_lines: 成年人是否需要麻疹加强针？
标准两剂疫苗可终身保护

subtitles.zh: 绝大多数人，标准的两剂儿童疫苗接种方案可提供终身保护。
subtitles.en: The vast vast majority of people, the standard two-dose childhood vaccination schedule will protect them for life.

subtitles.zh: 疫苗并非100%有效，但有效率超过95%，因此没有普遍推荐人群接种加强针。
subtitles.en: That doesn't mean that the vaccine is 100%, but it's pushing above 95%. So there's no generalized recommendation for boosters that are needed for the population.

subtitles.zh: 真正的问题在于从未接种过麻疹疫苗的人群，这才是疫情驱动的根源。
subtitles.en: It's really about people who've had zero doses of measles. That's what's driving this.

briefs.speaker: Dr. Amish Adolgez
briefs.speaker_context: Infectious disease expert and senior scholar at Johns Hopkins University Center for Health Security
briefs.current_title: 专家谈疫苗沟通策略：个性化对话比统一宣传更有效
current_title_lines: 个性化对话比统一宣传更有效

subtitles.zh: 我认为这取决于人们未接种的原因，有些人可能只是还没带孩子去接种。
subtitles.en: So I think it depends upon why someone is not vaccinated. There may be people who haven't gotten around to getting their children vaccinated.

subtitles.zh: 有些人可能对疫苗有疑问，需要根据具体情况采取不同策略。
subtitles.en: There may be people who have questions about vaccines. So you kind of have to take a different tack depending upon where someone is.

subtitles.zh: 电视上统一宣传与医生面对患者进行个性化沟通效果截然不同。
subtitles.en: And often it's very different to do it kind of as a one-size-fits-all message on television by a talking head versus a provider sitting in front of a patient or a patient's family.

subtitles.zh: 这是更好的方式，如果人们能在非评判的环境中解答疑问，他们更可能选择接种。
subtitles.en: And I think that's the better way to do it. We know that people will move towards vaccination if they can get their answers to the questions that they have in a non-judgmental way.

subtitles.zh: 这与应对RFK Jr.等散布虚假信息的人截然不同，对后者需要直接揭穿谎言。
subtitles.en: That's a very different type of rhetoric when you're dealing with the likes of RFK Jr. who is spreading disinformation where you just have to basically call him out for spreading lies.

subtitles.zh: 因此需要细致且个性化的方法，这很有效。我们知道家长信任家庭医生和初级保健提供者。
subtitles.en: So it's very kind of nuanced and very personalized. And that's what works. We know that parents trust family doctors, they trust their primary care providers.

subtitles.zh: 真正的改变发生在那里，而不是通过大喇叭喊话。
subtitles.en: That's where the actual movement occurs, not so much when someone's on blasting from a megaphone about the vaccine.

briefs.current_title: 专家：美国已实际失去麻疹消除状态，控制能力不再
current_title_lines: 美国已实际失去麻疹消除状态

subtitles.zh: 不，我认为美国实际上已经失去了消除状态。
subtitles.en: No, I think that the United States has effectively lost its elimination status.

subtitles.zh: 即使因技术原因保留消除状态，更深层的问题是：美国是否具备抵御麻疹的能力？答案是否定的。
subtitles.en: And even if by some technicality, it maintains its elimination status, the deeper question is does the United States have resiliency against measles? The answer is no.

subtitles.zh: 无论消除状态的决定如何，其中都涉及政治因素。
subtitles.en: Irrespective of what the elimination status decision is, and there will be politics around the elimination decision.

subtitles.zh: 因此，实际上美国已不再具备控制麻疹的能力。
subtitles.en: So I think it's just for all intents and purposes, the U.S. does not have the ability to control measles any longer.

subtitles.zh: 任何传染病都会导致混乱，人们无法正常进行日常活动。
subtitles.en: So anytime there's an infectious disease, it will lead to disruption. People can't go about their activities of daily life.

subtitles.zh: 如果孩子患麻疹，不能上学，父母可能得请假或雇人照看。
subtitles.en: Which means if it's a child of measles, that child can't go to school, that child's parents might have to stay home, that child's parents might have to hire someone to babysit.

subtitles.zh: 卫生部门还需调查接触者，进行追踪。
subtitles.en: And then you have a health department that then has to go and investigate who was the person in touch with? Do they need to contact people?

subtitles.zh: 是否需要采取措施阻止传播？所有这些都需要花钱。
subtitles.en: Do they need to do any kind of countermeasures to stop the measles from spreading in a given community? All of that costs money.

subtitles.zh: 这些本不必花费，因为麻疹病例是人为选择的结果。
subtitles.en: And it's money that doesn't need to be spent because these measles cases are happening voluntarily by people's choices.

subtitles.zh: 这不是自然力量，而是人们选择不给孩子接种疫苗，导致了本可避免的经济后果。
subtitles.en: This is not some force of nature. This is people's choice to not vaccinate their children. And then it has economic consequences that don't need to be incurred.

subtitles.zh: 传染病阻碍人类发展，这是另一个重要观点。
subtitles.en: And I think that's another important point to make with infectious diseases is that they keep humans from flourishing.

subtitles.zh: 人们因病卧床，无法生产创新，资金被挪用到本不该花的地方。
subtitles.en: Because they're stuck in bed sick and they're not out there producing, they're out there innovating, and you're taking money that could be used for some other concern.

subtitles.zh: 这些钱被投入到本不必投入的地方，而解决方案自1960年代就已存在。
subtitles.en: Now it's being put back to something, it's putting into something that we shouldn't have to be putting money into when we've had a solution to this since the 1960s.
